t: 詹姆斯·翁斯洛船长在克利奥号上重申了英国对福克兰群岛的主权.
te: Captain James Onslow, in the Clio, reasserts British sovereignty over the Falkland Islands.
dz: 詹姆斯·翁斯洛船长在克利奥号上重申了英国对福克兰群岛的主权.
de: Captain James Onslow, in the Clio, reasserts British sovereignty over the Falkland Islands.

dz: 美国总统安德鲁·杰克逊写信给副总统选举人马丁·范布伦(Martin Van Buren),表示他反对南卡罗来纳州在努利化危机中藐视联邦权威.
de: United States President Andrew Jackson writes to Vice President elect Martin Van Buren expressing his opposition to South Carolina's defiance of federal authority in the Nullification Crisis.

te: Otto becomes the first modern King of Greece.
dz: 奥托成为了第一位现代希腊国王.

t: 1833年的"公约"(The Convention of 1833)是一次由墨西哥德克萨斯州定…
te: The Convention of 1833, a political gathering of settlers in Mexican Texas to help draft a series of petitions to the M…
dz: 1833年的"公约"(The Convention of 1833)是一次由墨西哥德克萨斯州定居者组成的政治集会来帮助起草一系列向墨西哥政府提交的请愿书,开始于圣费利佩·德奥斯汀.
de: The Convention of 1833, a political gathering of settlers in Mexican Texas to help draft a series of petitions to the Mexican government, begins in San Felipe de Austin.

t: 越南南部爆发了针对明德皇帝的叛乱,明德皇帝亵渎了已去世的文人勒·范·杜耶特.
te: A revolt broke out in southern Vietnam against Emperor Minh Mang, who had desecrated the deceased mandarin Le Van Duyet.
dz: 越南南部爆发了针对明德皇帝的叛乱,明德皇帝亵渎了已去世的文人勒·范·杜耶特.
de: A revolt broke out in southern Vietnam against Emperor Minh Mang, who had desecrated the deceased mandarin Le Van Duyet.

te: The Chilean Constitution of 1833 is promulgated.
de: The Chilean Constitution of 1833 is promulgated.

dz: Lê Văn Khôi同27名士兵一起发动了一场兵变,占领了Phiên An城堡,演变为Lê Văn Khôi反抗明·明皇帝的起义.
de: Lê Văn Khôi along with 27 soldiers stage a mutiny taking over the Phiên An citadel, developing into the Lê Văn Khôi revolt against Emperor Minh Mạng.

t: 海军上将查尔斯·纳皮尔·范基什(Charles Napier vanquishes)是葡萄牙篡…
te: Admiral Charles Napier vanquishes the navy of the Portuguese usurper Dom Miguel at the third Battle of Cape St. Vincent.
dz: 海军上将查尔斯·纳皮尔·范基什(Charles Napier vanquishes)是葡萄牙篡夺者多姆·米格尔在第三次圣文森特角战役中的海军.
de: Admiral Charles Napier vanquishes the navy of the Portuguese usurper Dom Miguel at the third Battle of Cape St. Vincent.

t: 因在西澳大利亚州谋杀白人殖民者被通缉的诺恩加尔澳大利亚原住民战士雅根被杀死.
te: Noongar Australian aboriginal warrior Yagan, wanted for the murder of white colonists in Western Australia, is killed.
dz: 因在西澳大利亚州谋杀白人殖民者被通缉的诺恩加尔澳大利亚原住民战士雅根被杀死.
de: Noongar Australian aboriginal warrior Yagan, wanted for the murder of white colonists in Western Australia, is killed.

dz: "废除奴隶制法案"在英国下议院通过,开始在大英帝国大部分地区逐步废除奴隶制.
de: The Slavery Abolition Act passes in the British House of Commons, initiating the gradual abolition of slavery in most parts of the British Empire.

t: 伟大的1833年加德满都 比哈尔地震给尼泊尔,印度北部和西藏造成重大破坏,共造成500人死亡.

te: The Slavery Abolition Act 1833 receives royal assent, making the purchase or ownership of slaves illegal in the British…
dz: 1833年"废除奴隶制法"获得王室同意,使得奴隶的购买或所有权在大英帝国是非法的,但有例外.
de: The Slavery Abolition Act 1833 receives royal assent, making the purchase or ownership of slaves illegal in the British Empire with exceptions.
